runs.scenarioName: Canary #1 • Standard Balanced Cast (Full Roster)
runs.castSummary: Elia (Husband), Luke (Wife), Gabby (Sister-in-Law), Jason (Mistress), Kiri (Co-Worker), Matt (Bestie)

castAssignments.hydratedBio: Elia grew up on the same street as the rest of the group and went to high school with everyone at tonight's Christmas dinner. He has been married to Luke for five years, is siblings-in-law with Gabby, has been best friends with Matt since high school, and works at the same company as Kiri.

guest.name: Luke
guest.quirk: Brings up his air fryer constantly

castAssignments.hydratedBio: Luke grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Kiri and Matt) alongside her younger sister, Gabby. She has been married to Elia for five years after dating since high school. She also dated Kiri back in high school and used to be best friends with Jason when they were teenagers.

Gabby is Luke's younger sister and grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Kiri and Matt). She went to high school with Elia and Jason, and over the last few years she and Jason have become close best friends.

Jason went to high school with the whole group and has been married to Kiri for three years. She works at the same company as her brother-in-law, Matt. Back in high school she was best friends with Luke, and today she is close best friends with Gabby.

Kiri grew up right next door to the two sisters (Luke and Gabby) alongside his brother, Matt. He has been married to Jason for three years, works at the same company as Elia, and briefly dated Luke back when they were in high school.
Matt grew up next door to Luke and Gabby alongside his older brother, Kiri. He has been Elia's best friend since high school and works in the same office as his sister-in-law, Jason.

castAssignments.hydratedBio: Siobhán O'Connor grew up on the same street as the rest of the group and went to high school with everyone at tonight's Christmas dinner. He has been married to Jean-Luc Vance for five years, is siblings-in-law with Priya Sharma, has been best friends with Damon Ross since high school, and works at the same company as Zoe Sterling.

Jean-Luc Vance grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Zoe Sterling and Damon Ross) alongside her younger sister, Priya Sharma. She has been married to Siobhán O'Connor for five years after dating since high school. She also dated Zoe Sterling back in high school and used to be best friends with Marcus Chen when they were teenagers.

Priya Sharma is Jean-Luc Vance's younger sister and grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Zoe Sterling and Damon Ross). She went to high school with Siobhán O'Connor and Marcus Chen, and over the last few years she and Marcus Chen have become close best friends.

Marcus Chen went to high school with the whole group and has been married to Zoe Sterling for three years. She works at the same company as her brother-in-law, Damon Ross. Back in high school she was best friends with Jean-Luc Vance, and today she is close best friends with Priya Sharma.

Zoe Sterling grew up right next door to the two sisters (Jean-Luc Vance and Priya Sharma) alongside his brother, Damon Ross. He has been married to Marcus Chen for three years, works at the same company as Siobhán O'Connor, and briefly dated Jean-Luc Vance back when they were in high school.

Damon Ross grew up next door to Jean-Luc Vance and Priya Sharma alongside his older brother, Zoe Sterling. He has been Siobhán O'Connor's best friend since high school and works in the same office as his sister-in-law, Marcus Chen.

runs.castSummary: Priya Sharma (Husband), Marcus Chen (Wife), Zoe Sterling (Sister-in-Law), Damon Ross (Mistress), Maya Lin (Co-Worker), Liam Brooks (Bestie)

castAssignments.hydratedBio: Priya Sharma grew up on the same street as the rest of the group and went to high school with everyone at tonight's Christmas dinner. He has been married to Marcus Chen for five years, is siblings-in-law with Zoe Sterling, has been best friends with Liam Brooks since high school, and works at the same company as Maya Lin.

Marcus Chen grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Maya Lin and Liam Brooks) alongside her younger sister, Zoe Sterling. She has been married to Priya Sharma for five years after dating since high school. She also dated Maya Lin back in high school and used to be best friends with Damon Ross when they were teenagers.

Zoe Sterling is Marcus Chen's younger sister and grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Maya Lin and Liam Brooks). She went to high school with Priya Sharma and Damon Ross, and over the last few years she and Damon Ross have become close best friends.

Damon Ross went to high school with the whole group and has been married to Maya Lin for three years. She works at the same company as her brother-in-law, Liam Brooks. Back in high school she was best friends with Marcus Chen, and today she is close best friends with Zoe Sterling.

guest.name: Maya Lin
guest.quirk: Eats dessert before dinner every time

castAssignments.hydratedBio: Maya Lin grew up right next door to the two sisters (Marcus Chen and Zoe Sterling) alongside his brother, Liam Brooks. He has been married to Damon Ross for three years, works at the same company as Priya Sharma, and briefly dated Marcus Chen back when they were in high school.

Liam Brooks grew up next door to Marcus Chen and Zoe Sterling alongside his older brother, Maya Lin. He has been Priya Sharma's best friend since high school and works in the same office as his sister-in-law, Damon Ross.

runs.scenarioName: Run #11 • Reversed Couples & Sibling Seating Order
runs.castSummary: Matt (Husband), Kiri (Wife), Jason (Sister-in-Law), Gabby (Mistress), Luke (Co-Worker), Elia (Bestie)

castAssignments.hydratedBio: Matt grew up on the same street as the rest of the group and went to high school with everyone at tonight's Christmas dinner. He has been married to Kiri for five years, is siblings-in-law with Jason, has been best friends with Elia since high school, and works at the same company as Luke.

Kiri grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Luke and Elia) alongside her younger sister, Jason. She has been married to Matt for five years after dating since high school. She also dated Luke back in high school and used to be best friends with Gabby when they were teenagers.

Jason is Kiri's younger sister and grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Luke and Elia). She went to high school with Matt and Gabby, and over the last few years she and Gabby have become close best friends.

Gabby went to high school with the whole group and has been married to Luke for three years. She works at the same company as her brother-in-law, Elia. Back in high school she was best friends with Kiri, and today she is close best friends with Jason.

guest.name: Luke
guest.quirk: Brings up his air fryer constantly

castAssignments.hydratedBio: Luke grew up right next door to the two sisters (Kiri and Jason) alongside his brother, Elia. He has been married to Gabby for three years, works at the same company as Matt, and briefly dated Kiri back when they were in high school.
Elia grew up next door to Kiri and Jason alongside his older brother, Luke. He has been Matt's best friend since high school and works in the same office as his sister-in-law, Gabby.

castAssignments.hydratedBio: Gabby grew up on the same street as the rest of the group and went to high school with everyone at tonight's Christmas dinner. He has been married to Elia for five years, is siblings-in-law with Kiri, has been best friends with Zoe Sterling since high school, and works at the same company as Priya Sharma.

Elia grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Priya Sharma and Zoe Sterling) alongside her younger sister, Kiri. She has been married to Gabby for five years after dating since high school. She also dated Priya Sharma back in high school and used to be best friends with Siobhán O'Connor when they were teenagers.

Kiri is Elia's younger sister and grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Priya Sharma and Zoe Sterling). She went to high school with Gabby and Siobhán O'Connor, and over the last few years she and Siobhán O'Connor have become close best friends.

Siobhán O'Connor went to high school with the whole group and has been married to Priya Sharma for three years. She works at the same company as her brother-in-law, Zoe Sterling. Back in high school she was best friends with Elia, and today she is close best friends with Kiri.

Priya Sharma grew up right next door to the two sisters (Elia and Kiri) alongside his brother, Zoe Sterling. He has been married to Siobhán O'Connor for three years, works at the same company as Gabby, and briefly dated Elia back when they were in high school.

Zoe Sterling grew up next door to Elia and Kiri alongside his older brother, Priya Sharma. He has been Gabby's best friend since high school and works in the same office as his sister-in-law, Siobhán O'Connor.

castAssignments.hydratedBio: Maya Lin grew up on the same street as the rest of the group and went to high school with everyone at tonight's Christmas dinner. Chloe Meyer grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Siobhán O'Connor and Kiri) alongside her younger sister, Zoe Sterling. Siobhán O'Connor grew up right next door to the two sisters (Chloe Meyer and Zoe Sterling) alongside his brother, Kiri. He has been married to Priya Sharma for three years, works at the same company as Maya Lin, and briefly dated Chloe Meyer back when they were in high school.

Kiri grew up next door to Chloe Meyer and Zoe Sterling alongside his older brother, Siobhán O'Connor. He has been Maya Lin's best friend since high school and works in the same office as his sister-in-law, Priya Sharma.

Damon Ross grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Charley and Matt) alongside her younger sister, Marcus Chen. She has been married to Liam Brooks for five years after dating since high school. She also dated Charley back in high school and used to be best friends with Jean-Luc Vance when they were teenagers.

Marcus Chen is Damon Ross's younger sister and grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Charley and Matt). She went to high school with Liam Brooks and Jean-Luc Vance, and over the last few years she and Jean-Luc Vance have become close best friends.

Jean-Luc Vance went to high school with the whole group and has been married to Charley for three years. She works at the same company as her brother-in-law, Matt. Back in high school she was best friends with Damon Ross, and today she is close best friends with Marcus Chen.

Charley grew up right next door to the two sisters (Damon Ross and Marcus Chen) alongside his brother, Matt. He has been married to Jean-Luc Vance for three years, works at the same company as Liam Brooks, and briefly dated Damon Ross back when they were in high school.

Matt grew up next door to Damon Ross and Marcus Chen alongside his older brother, Charley. He has been Liam Brooks's best friend since high school and works in the same office as his sister-in-law, Jean-Luc Vance.

castAssignments.hydratedBio: Luke grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Kiri and Matt) alongside her younger sister, Gabby. She has been married to Elia for five years after dating since high school. She also dated Kiri back in high school and used to be best friends with Jason when they were teenagers.

Gabby is Luke's younger sister and grew up next door to the two neighbour brothers (Kiri and Matt). She went to high school with Elia and Jason, and over the last few years she and Jason have become close best friends.

Jason went to high school with the whole group and has been married to Kiri for three years. She works at the same company as her brother-in-law, Matt. Back in high school she was best friends with Luke, and today she is close best friends with Gabby.

Kiri grew up right next door to the two sisters (Luke and Gabby) alongside his brother, Matt. He has been married to Jason for three years, works at the same company as Elia, and briefly dated Luke back when they were in high school.
Matt grew up next door to Luke and Gabby alongside his older brother, Kiri. He has been Elia's best friend since high school and works in the same office as his sister-in-law, Jason.
